title: SPAR-Hate: An Auditor-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Bilingual Hate Speech Parsing

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to accurately interpret culturally situated hate speech, implicit attacks, coded expressions, and local slang using a multi-agent framework featuring a 'Cultural Bystander' role.

Measuring and comparing structured hate speech parsing performance across English (TBO benchmark) and Chinese (STATE-ToxiCN benchmark) to address cross-lingual fragility and the skew towards Western representations in large language models.

Extracting and evaluating targets, arguments, and group labels related to regional stereotypes and discrimination (e.g., against populations from Henan, Northeast China, or Xinjiang) using the Chinese quadruple extraction task.
Parsing multi-target hate speech tuples to accurately identify and extract gender-based stereotypes, disparagement, and derogatory terms directed at men or women in both English and Chinese text.
